newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - San Mateo-Foster, Calif.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - San Mateo-Foster, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL
Not to Exceed $11,000,000
San Mateo-Foster
City School District
(County of San Mateo, State of California)
General Obligation Bonds
Election of 1997, Series 1997
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the above Bonds will be
offered for public sale by the Board of Trustees of the San
Mateo-Foster City School District, County of San Mateo,
State of California, on
Wednesday, July 30, 1997,
at the hour of 10:00 A.M., California time (or on such other
date and time as may be determined by the Superintendent of
the District as provided in the paragraph below), at the
offices of Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP, 400 Sansome
Street, San Francisco, CA 94111, subject to all of the terms
and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale describing the
Bonds, copies of which (along with a Preliminary Official
Statement relating to the Bonds) will be furnished upon
request to the Financial Advisor to the District, Stone &
Youngberg LLC, 50 California Street, 35th Floor, San
Francisco, CA 94111, telephone (415) 981-1314, fax (415)
415-2395. Legal Opinion: Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP,
San Francisco, California.
Any sale date for the Bonds may be changed at the sole
discretion of the Superintendent of the District by
providing notice thereof through Thompson Municipal News and
Bloomberg Business News at least twenty-four (24) hours
prior to the then-scheduled sale date of the Bonds.
Dated: July 8, 1997.
/s/ Melodie L. Lew
Clerk of the Board of Trustees
San Mateo-Foster City School District
(From The Bond Buyer)
